# List Ledger Entries

Returns a list of ledger entries.
By default, entries from fiscal periods that are closed or frozen are excluded.
However, if a 'date' filter is provided, it will return all entries within the specified date range, even if they fall within a closed or frozen fiscal period.


> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `ledger`


# OpenAPI definition
```json

        "operationId": "getLedgerEntries",
        "summary": "List Ledger Entries",
        "description": "Returns a list of ledger entries.\nBy default, entries from fiscal periods that are closed or frozen are excluded.\nHowever, if a 'date' filter is provided, it will return all entries within the specified date range, even if they fall within a closed or frozen fiscal period.\n\n\n> ℹ️\n> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `ledger`",
        "tags": [
          "Ledger Entries"
        ],
        "security": [
          {
            "oauth2": [
              "ledger"
            ]
          }
        ],
        "parameters": [
          {
            "name": "page",
            "description": "Items are paginated, this is the current page which will be returned. The page index is starting at 1.",
            "in": "query",
            "schema": {
              "type": "integer",
              "example": 1
            }
          },
          {
            "name": "per_page",
            "description": "Items are paginated. By default, you get 20 items per page. You can specify another number of items per page.",
            "in": "query",
            "schema": {
              "type": "integer",
              "example": 20,
              "minimum": 1,
              "maximum": 100
            }
          },
          {
            "name": "filter",
            "description": "You can choose to filter items on specific fields.\nAvailable fields and values:\n- `updated_at, created_at, date`: `lt, lteq, gt, gteq, eq, not_eq`\n- `journal_id`: `lt, lteq, gt, gteq, eq, not_eq`, `in`, `not_in`\n",
            "in": "query",
```

# Upload a file

Upload a file to attach to a ledger entry. The maximum allowed file size is 100MB.
Note that this will not upload a file into the DMS (GED).


> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `ledger`

# Link Analytical Categories to a Ledger Entry line

This endpoint replaces already existing categories on the Ledger Entry line with new values.
If an empty array of categories_ids is provided, it will remove all categories from the Ledger Entry line.


> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `ledger`

# Letter ledger entry lines

This endpoint lets you letter ledger entry lines together. All received entry lines will be lettered together. If a passed entry line is already lettered, then the lettering will be applied to its associated lettered entry lines as well.

> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `ledger`


# OpenAPI definition
```json
{
  "openapi": "3.0.1",

        "operationId": "postLedgerEntryLinesLetter",
        "summary": "Letter ledger entry lines",
        "description": "This endpoint lets you letter ledger entry lines together. All received entry lines will be lettered together. If a passed entry line is already lettered, then the lettering will be applied to its associated lettered entry lines as well.\n\n> ℹ️\n> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `ledger`",
        "tags": [
          "Ledger Entry Lines"
        ],
        "security": [
          {
            "oauth2": [
              "ledger"

                "type": "object",
                "additionalProperties": false,

                  "unbalanced_lettering_strategy": {
                    "description": "- `none`: the API won't let you create an unbalanced lettering\nand will respond with an error.\n- `partial`: a potentially unbalanced lettering will be created.\n",
                    "type": "string",
                    "enum": [
                      "none",
                      "partial"
                    ]

                    "description": "The list of ledger entry lines you want to letter together.\n\nYou can provide ledger entry lines already lettered and they don't have to be part of the same lettering.\n\nAll received entry lines will be lettered together. If a passed entry line is already lettered, then the lettering will be applied to its lettered entry lines as well. For example:\nLedger entry lines `A` and `B` are already lettered together. `C` in not lettered.\nWhen requesting `[A, C]` to be lettered, the final lettering will be `[A, B, C]`.\n",
                    "type": "array",

                      "type": "object",
```

```json
              "example": "dXBkYXRlZF9hdDoxNjc0MTIzNDU2"
            },
            "required": false
          },
          {
            "name": "limit",
            "description": "Number of items to return per request.\nDefaults to 20 if not specified.\nMust be between 1 and 100.\n",
            "in": "query",
            "schema": {
              "type": "integer",
              "example": 20,
              "minimum": 1,
              "maximum": 100
            },
            "required": false
          },
          {
            "name": "filter",
            "description": "You can choose to filter items on specific fields.\nAvailable fields and values:\n- `id`, `start`, `customer_id`: `lt`, `lteq`, `gt`, `gteq`, `eq`, `not_eq`, `in`, `not_in`\n- `status`: `eq`, `not_eq`, `in`, `not_in`\n",
            "in": "query",
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",
              "example": "[{\"field\": \"status\", \"operator\": \"eq\", \"value\": \"in_progress\"}]"
            }
          },
          {
            "name": "sort",
            "description": "You can choose to sort items on specific attributes\nSort field may be prefixed with `-` for descending order.\nExample : `id` will sort by ascending order, `-id` will sort by descending order.\nAvailable fields : `id`\n",
            "in": "query",
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",
              "default": "-id",
              "example": "id"
            }
          }

        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "description": "Returns a list of billing subscriptions",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "additionalProperties": false,
                  "properties": {
                    "has_more": {
                      "description": "Indicates whether additional results are available beyond this set.\nUse this flag to determine if another request is needed.\n",
                      "type": "boolean",
                      "example": true
                    },
                    "next_cursor": {
                      "description": "Cursor to retrieve the next set of results.\nInclude this value in the cursor parameter of your next request to fetch subsequent items.\nA `null` `next_cursor` in the response indicates no further results.\n",
                      "type": "string",
                      "nullable": true,
                      "example": "dXBkYXRlZF9hdDoxNjc0MTIzNDU2"
                    },
                    "items": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "object",
                        "additionalProperties": false,
                        "properties": {
                          "id": {
                            "description": "Billing subscription identifier",
                            "type": "integer",
                            "example": 42
                          },
                          "next_occurrence": {
                            "description": "The date for the next subscription renewal",
                            "type": "string",
                            "format": "date",
                            "nullable": true,
                            "example": "2023-01-01"
                          },
                          "prev_occurrence": {
                            "description": "The date of the previous subscription renewal",
                            "type": "string",
                            "format": "date",
                            "nullable": true,
                            "example": "2023-01-01"
                          },
                          "stopped_at": {
                            "description": "The exact timestamp when the subscription was terminated",
                            "type": "string",
                            "format": "date-time",
                            "nullable": true,
                            "example": "2023-08-30T10:08:08.146343Z"
                          },
                          "start": {
                            "description": "The subscription start date",
                            "type": "string",
                            "format": "date",
                            "example": "2023-01-01"
                          },
                          "finish": {
                            "description": "The date for when the subscription will end",
                            "type": "string",
                            "format": "date",
                            "nullable": true,
                            "example": "2023-12-31"
                          },
                          "status": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "enum": [
                              "draft",
                              "stopped",
                              "finished",
                              "pending",
                              "not_started",
                              "in_progress"
                            ]
                          },
                          "mode": {
                            "description": "- `awaiting_validation`: generated invoices will be in draft\n- `finalized`: generated invoices will be finalized\n- `email`: generated invoices will be finalized and sent by email to the recipients configured on the subscription\n",
                            "type": "string",
                            "enum": [
                              "awaiting_validation",
                              "finalized",
                              "email"
                            ]
                          },
                          "activated_at": {
                            "description": "The exact timestamp for when the subscription was activated",
                            "type": "string",
                            "format": "date-time",
                            "nullable": true,
                            "example": "2023-08-30T10:08:08.146343Z"
                          },
                          "payment_conditions": {
                            "oneOf": [
                              {
                                "type": "string",

                                  "upon_receipt",
                                  "7_days",
                                  "15_days",
                                  "30_days",
                                  "30_days_end_of_month",
                                  "45_days",
                                  "45_days_end_of_month",
                                  "60_days"

                                "nullable": true,
                                "enum": [
                                  null
                                ]
                              }
                            ]

                          "payment_method": {
                            "description": "Payment method\noffline means the subscription is not linked to a payment method\ngocardless_direct-debit means at each new occurrence the client will be automatically debited thanks to GoCardless. To do so, you need a [GoCardless account and link it to your Pennylane account](https://help.pennylane.com/fr/articles/18730-gocardless-faq).\n",

                              "gocardless_direct_debit"

                                "items": {
                                  "type": "string",
                                  "format": "email"

                              },
```

# Get a billing subscription

This endpoint returns a specific billing subscription.

> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `billing_subscriptions:all`, `billing_subscriptions:readonly`


# OpenAPI definition
```json
{
  "openapi": "3.0.1",
  "info": {
    "title": "Accounting",
    "contact": {
      "email": "tech@pennylane.com"
    },
    "version": "2.0"
  },
  "servers": [
    {
      "url": "https://app.pennylane.com"
    }
  ],
  "paths": {
    "/api/external/v2/billing_subscriptions/{id}": {
      "get": {
        "operationId": "getBillingSubscription",
        "summary": "Get a billing subscription",
        "description": "This endpoint returns a specific billing subscription.\n\n> ℹ️\n> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `billing_subscriptions:all`, `billing_subscriptions:readonly`",
        "tags": [
          "Billing Subscriptions"
        ],
        "security": [
          {
            "oauth2": [
              "billing_subscriptions:all",
              "billing_subscriptions:readonly"
            ]
          }
        ],
        "parameters": [
          {
            "name": "id",
            "description": "The ID of the billing subscription to retrieve",
            "in": "path",
            "schema": {
              "type": "integer",
              "example": 42
            },
            "required": true
          }
        ],
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "description": "Returns the requested billing subscription",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "additionalProperties": false,
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "description": "Billing subscription identifier",
                      "type": "integer",
                      "example": 42
                    },
                    "next_occurrence": {
                      "description": "The date for the next subscription renewal",
                      "type": "string",
                      "format": "date",
                      "nullable": true,
                      "example": "2023-01-01"
                    },
                    "prev_occurrence": {
                      "description": "The date of the previous subscription renewal",
                      "type": "string",
                      "format": "date",
                      "nullable": true,
                      "example": "2023-01-01"
                    },
                    "stopped_at": {
                      "description": "The exact timestamp when the subscription was terminated",
                      "type": "string",
                      "format": "date-time",
                      "nullable": true,
                      "example": "2023-08-30T10:08:08.146343Z"
                    },
                    "start": {
                      "description": "The subscription start date",
                      "type": "string",
                      "format": "date",
                      "example": "2023-01-01"
                    },
                    "finish": {
                      "description": "The date for when the subscription will end",
                      "type": "string",
                      "format": "date",
                      "nullable": true,
                      "example": "2023-12-31"
                    },
                    "status": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "draft",
                        "stopped",
                        "finished",
                        "pending",
                        "not_started",
                        "in_progress"
                      ]
                    },
                    "mode": {
                      "description": "- `awaiting_validation`: generated invoices will be in draft\n- `finalized`: generated invoices will be finalized\n- `email`: generated invoices will be finalized and sent by email to the recipients configured on the subscription\n",
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "awaiting_validation",
                        "finalized",
                        "email"
                      ]
                    },
                    "activated_at": {
                      "description": "The exact timestamp for when the subscription was activated",

                      "format": "date-time",
                      "nullable": true,
                      "example": "2023-08-30T10:08:08.146343Z"
                    },
                    "payment_conditions": {
```

> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `billing_subscriptions:all`

```json
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "description": "Renders the updated billing subscription",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "additionalProperties": false,
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "description": "Billing subscription identifier",
                      "type": "integer",
                      "example": 42
                    },
                    "next_occurrence": {
                      "description": "The date for the next subscription renewal",
                      "type": "string",
                      "format": "date",
                      "nullable": true,
                      "example": "2023-01-01"
                    },
                    "prev_occurrence": {
                      "description": "The date of the previous subscription renewal",
                      "type": "string",
                      "format": "date",
                      "nullable": true,
                      "example": "2023-01-01"
                    },
                    "stopped_at": {
                      "description": "The exact timestamp when the subscription was terminated",
                      "type": "string",
                      "format": "date-time",
                      "nullable": true,
                      "example": "2023-08-30T10:08:08.146343Z"
                    },
                    "start": {
                      "description": "The subscription start date",
                      "type": "string",
                      "format": "date",
                      "example": "2023-01-01"
                    },
                    "finish": {
                      "description": "The date for when the subscription will end",
                      "type": "string",
                      "format": "date",
                      "nullable": true,
                      "example": "2023-12-31"
                    },
                    "status": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "draft",
                        "stopped",
                        "finished",
                        "pending",
                        "not_started",
                        "in_progress"
                      ]
                    },
                    "mode": {
                      "description": "- `awaiting_validation`: generated invoices will be in draft\n- `finalized`: generated invoices will be finalized\n- `email`: generated invoices will be finalized and sent by email to the recipients configured on the subscription\n",
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "awaiting_validation",
                        "finalized",
                        "email"
                      ]
                    },
                    "activated_at": {
                      "description": "The exact timestamp for when the subscription was activated",
                      "type": "string",
                      "format": "date-time",
                      "nullable": true,
                      "example": "2023-08-30T10:08:08.146343Z"
                    },
                    "payment_conditions": {
                      "oneOf": [
                        {
                          "type": "string",
                          "enum": [
                            "upon_receipt",
                            "7_days",
                            "15_days",
                            "30_days",
                            "30_days_end_of_month",
                            "45_days",
                            "45_days_end_of_month",
                            "60_days"
                          ]
                        },
                        {
                          "type": "string",
                          "nullable": true,
                          "enum": [
                            null
                          ]
                        }
                      ]
                    },
                    "payment_method": {
                      "description": "Payment method\noffline means the subscription is not linked to a payment method\ngocardless_direct-debit means at each new occurrence the client will be automatically debited thanks to GoCardless. To do so, you need a [GoCardless account and link it to your Pennylane account](https://help.pennylane.com/fr/articles/18730-gocardless-faq).\n",
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "offline",
                        "gocardless_direct_debit"
                      ]
                    },
                    "email_settings": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "nullable": true,
                      "additionalProperties": false,
                      "properties": {
                        "recipients": {
                          "description": "Primary email recipients for invoice delivery",
                          "type": "array",
                          "items": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "format": "email"
                          }
                        },
                        "billing_email_template": {
                          "type": "object",
                          "nullable": true,
                          "additionalProperties": false,
                          "properties": {
                            "id": {
                              "type": "integer"
                            },
                            "label": {
                              "type": "string"
                            }
                          },
                          "required": [
                            "id",
                            "label"
                          ]
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [
                        "recipients",
                        "billing_email_template"
                      ]
                    },
                    "recurring_rule": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "additionalProperties": false,
                      "properties": {
                        "day_of_month": {
                          "type": "array",
                          "nullable": true,
                          "items": {
                            "type": "number"
                          }
                        },
                        "week_start": {
                          "type": "number",
                          "nullable": true
                        },
                        "day": {
                          "type": "array",
                          "nullable": true,
                          "items": {
                            "type": "number"
                          }
                        },
                        "rule_type": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "example": "monthly",
                          "enum": [
                            "weekly",
                            "monthly",
                            "yearly"
                          ]
                        },
                        "interval": {
                          "type": "integer",
                          "nullable": true
                        },
                        "count": {
                          "description": "Number of occurrences of the recurring rule",
                          "example": 12,
                          "type": "integer",
                          "nullable": true
                        },
                        "until": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "nullable": true
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [
                        "day_of_month",
                        "week_start",
                        "day",
                        "rule_type",
                        "interval",
                        "count",
                        "until"
                      ]
                    },
                    "customer": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "nullable": true,
                      "additionalProperties": false,
                      "properties": {
                        "id": {
                          "type": "integer",
                          "example": 42
                        },
                        "url": {
                          "description": "URL to get the customer.",
                          "type": "string",
                          "example": "https://app.pennylane.com/api/external/v2/customers/42"
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [
                        "id",
                        "url"
                      ]
                    },
                    "customer_invoice_data": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "nullable": false,
                      "additionalProperties": false,
                      "properties": {
                        "label": {
                          "description": "Invoice label",
                          "type": "string",
                          "nullable": true,
                          "example": "Demo label"
                        },
                        "currency": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "default": "EUR",
                          "enum": [
                            "EUR",
                            "USD",
                            "GBP",
                            "AED",
                            "AFN",
                            "ALL",
                            "AMD",
                            "ANG",
                            "AOA",
                            "ARS",
                            "AUD",
                            "AWG",
                            "AZN",
                            "BAM",
                            "BBD",
                            "BDT",
                            "BGN",
                            "BHD",
                            "BIF",
                            "BMD",
                            "BND",
                            "BOB",
```

# Create a billing subscription

This endpoint allows you to create a subscription. Pennylane will generate the customer invoice each month.
You can also link the subscription to a GoCardless mandate.


> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `billing_subscriptions:all`

```json
        "responses": {
          "201": {
            "description": "Renders the created billing subscription",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "additionalProperties": false,
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "description": "Billing subscription identifier",
                      "type": "integer",
                      "example": 42
                    },
                    "next_occurrence": {
                      "description": "The date for the next subscription renewal",
                      "type": "string",
                      "format": "date",
                      "nullable": true,
                      "example": "2023-01-01"
                    },
                    "prev_occurrence": {
                      "description": "The date of the previous subscription renewal",
                      "type": "string",
                      "format": "date",
                      "nullable": true,
                      "example": "2023-01-01"
                    },
                    "stopped_at": {
                      "description": "The exact timestamp when the subscription was terminated",
                      "type": "string",
                      "format": "date-time",
                      "nullable": true,
                      "example": "2023-08-30T10:08:08.146343Z"
                    },
                    "start": {
                      "description": "The subscription start date",
                      "type": "string",
                      "format": "date",
                      "example": "2023-01-01"
                    },
                    "finish": {
                      "description": "The date for when the subscription will end",
                      "type": "string",
                      "format": "date",
                      "nullable": true,
                      "example": "2023-12-31"
                    },
                    "status": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "draft",
                        "stopped",
                        "finished",
                        "pending",
                        "not_started",
                        "in_progress"
                      ]
                    },
                    "mode": {
                      "description": "- `awaiting_validation`: generated invoices will be in draft\n- `finalized`: generated invoices will be finalized\n- `email`: generated invoices will be finalized and sent by email to the recipients configured on the subscription\n",
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "awaiting_validation",
                        "finalized",
                        "email"
                      ]
                    },
                    "activated_at": {
                      "description": "The exact timestamp for when the subscription was activated",
                      "type": "string",
                      "format": "date-time",
                      "nullable": true,
                      "example": "2023-08-30T10:08:08.146343Z"
                    },
                    "payment_conditions": {
                      "oneOf": [
                        {
                          "type": "string",
                          "enum": [
                            "upon_receipt",
                            "7_days",
                            "15_days",
                            "30_days",
                            "30_days_end_of_month",
                            "45_days",
                            "45_days_end_of_month",
                            "60_days"
                          ]
                        },
                        {
                          "type": "string",
                          "nullable": true,
                          "enum": [
                            null
                          ]
                        }
                      ]
                    },
                    "payment_method": {
                      "description": "Payment method\noffline means the subscription is not linked to a payment method\ngocardless_direct-debit means at each new occurrence the client will be automatically debited thanks to GoCardless. To do so, you need a [GoCardless account and link it to your Pennylane account](https://help.pennylane.com/fr/articles/18730-gocardless-faq).\n",
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "offline",
                        "gocardless_direct_debit"
                      ]
                    },
                    "email_settings": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "nullable": true,
                      "additionalProperties": false,
                      "properties": {
                        "recipients": {
                          "description": "Primary email recipients for invoice delivery",
                          "type": "array",
                          "items": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "format": "email"
                          }
                        },
                        "billing_email_template": {
                          "type": "object",
                          "nullable": true,
                          "additionalProperties": false,
                          "properties": {
                            "id": {
                              "type": "integer"
                            },
                            "label": {
                              "type": "string"
                            }
                          },
                          "required": [
                            "id",
                            "label"
                          ]
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [
                        "recipients",
                        "billing_email_template"
                      ]
                    },
                    "recurring_rule": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "additionalProperties": false,
                      "properties": {
                        "day_of_month": {
                          "type": "array",
                          "nullable": true,
                          "items": {
                            "type": "number"
                          }
                        },
                        "week_start": {
                          "type": "number",
                          "nullable": true
                        },
                        "day": {
                          "type": "array",
                          "nullable": true,
                          "items": {
                            "type": "number"
                          }
                        },
                        "rule_type": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "example": "monthly",
                          "enum": [
                            "weekly",
                            "monthly",
                            "yearly"
                          ]
                        },
                        "interval": {
                          "type": "integer",
                          "nullable": true
                        },
                        "count": {
                          "description": "Number of occurrences of the recurring rule",
                          "example": 12,
                          "type": "integer",
                          "nullable": true
                        },
                        "until": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "nullable": true
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [
                        "day_of_month",
                        "week_start",
                        "day",
                        "rule_type",
                        "interval",
                        "count",
                        "until"
                      ]
                    },
                    "customer": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "nullable": true,
                      "additionalProperties": false,
                      "properties": {
                        "id": {
                          "type": "integer",

                          "type": "string",
```

# Get customer invoices changes events

Returns the list of changes based on the provided `start_date`.
If no `start_date` is provided it returns the oldest set of recorded changes.
Changes for the last 4 weeks are retained. The items will be returned using
`processed_at` in ASC order (oldest first).


> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `customer_invoices:all`, `customer_invoices:readonly`

# Get supplier changes events

Returns the list of changes based on the provided `start_date`.
If no `start_date` is provided it returns the oldest set of recorded changes.
Changes for the last 4 weeks are retained. The items will be returned using
`processed_at` in ASC order (oldest first).


> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `suppliers:all`, `suppliers:readonly`


# OpenAPI definition
```json
{
  "openapi": "3.0.1",
  "info": {
    "title": "Accounting",
    "contact": {
      "email": "tech@pennylane.com"
    },
    "version": "2.0"
  },
  "servers": [
    {
      "url": "https://app.pennylane.com"
    }
  ],
```

# Get customer changes events

Returns the list of changes based on the provided `start_date`.
If no `start_date` is provided it returns the oldest set of recorded changes.
Changes for the last 4 weeks are retained. The items will be returned using
`processed_at` in ASC order (oldest first).


> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `customers:all`, `customers:readonly`

# Get product change events

Returns the list of changes based on the provided `start_date`.
If no `start_date` is provided it returns the oldest set of recorded changes.
Changes for the last 4 weeks are retained. The items will be returned using
`processed_at` in ASC order (oldest first).


> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `products:all`, `products:readonly`

# Get transaction change events

Returns the list of changes based on the provided `start_date`.
If no `start_date` is provided it returns the oldest set of recorded changes.
Changes for the last 4 weeks are retained. The items will be returned using
`processed_at` in ASC order (oldest first).


> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `transactions:readonly`


# OpenAPI definition
```json
{
  "openapi": "3.0.1",
  "info": {
    "title": "Accounting",
    "contact": {
      "email": "tech@pennylane.com"
    },
    "version": "2.0"
  },
```

This endpoint lists commercial documents.

> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `commercial_documents:all`, `commercial_documents:readonly`

# Retrieve a commercial document

This endpoint retrieves a commercial document.

> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `commercial_documents:all`, `commercial_documents:readonly`

# Upload an appendix for a commercial document

Upload a file that will be an appendix attached to a commercial document.

Note that this will not upload a file into the DMS (GED).

List matched transactions for a customer invoice

# Retrieve a customer invoice

Retrieve a customer invoice or a credit note

> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `customer_invoices:all`, `customer_invoices:readonly`

# Upload an appendix for a customer invoice

Upload a file that will be an appendix attached to a customer invoice.

Note that this will not upload a file into the DMS (GED).

# Send a customer invoice by email

This endpoint allows you to send a finalized, imported customer invoice or credit note
by email to your customer. This requires that the PDF file for that document
has been generated (this process can take a few minutes), so if you just created
the invoice in our system, we may return a 409 error. You should
retry the request in a few minutes - if you receive a 204 response, that means
that the email is on its way. For more information about email sending, please
read [this guide](https://pennylane.readme.io/v2.0/docs/sending-documents-by-email).


> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `customer_invoices:all`

# Create a customer invoice

This endpoint allows you to create a draft or finalized customer
invoice or credit note


> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `customer_invoices:all`

# Import an invoice with file attached

This endpoint allows you to import an invoice.

ℹ️ To ensure consistency, **we will apply validations on amounts in accordance with our rounding policy**. We allow a difference of up to 1 euro between total amounts and the sum of invoice lines. For further details, please refer to our [article](https://help.pennylane.com/fr/articles/61575-comprendre-l-arrondi-de-tva-d-un-produit) on rounding policy.


> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `customer_invoices:all`

```json
                        },

                        },
```

# Create a customer invoice from a quote

This endpoint allows you to create a customer invoice from an existing quote.
The invoice will inherit the quote's data (customer, lines, etc.).


> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `customer_invoices:all`

```json
                                        "relative"

                                    "value"

                        "type": "string",

                  {

                            "type": "string",

                        "type": "object",
                        "additionalProperties": false,
                        "properties": {
```

```json
                            "type": "array",

                              "type": "object",

                                  "description": "Invoice line identifier",

                                  "type": "object",
                                  "additionalProperties": false,
                                  "properties": {
                                    "start_date": {
                                      "description": "Start date of the imputation period (ISO 8601)",

                                      "example": "2020-06-30"

                                    "end_date": {
                                      "description": "End date of the imputation period (ISO 8601)",

                                }

                              "required": [

                            }
                          }
                        }
                      },
                      "external_reference": {

                        "type": "string",
                        "example": "FR123"
```

# Categorize a customer invoice

This endpoint is not applicable for draft invoices.
Update the categories of a customer invoice. You can pass categories that don't belong to the same category group. The sum of categories of a same group must equal `1`. In the following example, the two first categories belong to the same category group A, the sum of the weights is `1`. The third category belongs to a category group B, its weight is `1`.
```
[
  { "id": 59, "weight": "0.5" }, // category group A
  { "id": 33, "weight": "0.5" }, // category group A
  { "id": 65, "weight": "1" } // category group B
]
```


> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `customer_invoices:all`

# Turn the draft invoice into a finalized invoice.

Convert the draft customer invoice or credit note into a finalized
one. Once finalized, the resource can no longer be edited.


> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `customer_invoices:all`


# OpenAPI definition
```json
{
  "openapi": "3.0.1",

    }

        "operationId": "finalizeCustomerInvoice",
        "summary": "Turn the draft invoice into a finalized invoice.",
        "description": "Convert the draft customer invoice or credit note into a finalized\none. Once finalized, the resource can no longer be edited.\n\n\n> ℹ️\n> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `customer_invoices:all`",
```

# Mark a customer invoice as paid

Mark a customer invoice as paid. No automatic reconciliation will
be done once the invoice is marked as paid


> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `customer_invoices:all`

# Update an Imported customer invoice

Update an imported customer invoice or credit note. It is not
applicable for draft invoices.


> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `customer_invoices:all`

```json
                      "nullable": true,
                      "example": "20.0"
                    },
                    "remaining_amount_without_tax": {
                      "description": "The remaining amount without VAT to pay for the invoice to be considered paid",

                      "nullable": true,

                      "type": "object",
```

This endpoint returns an individual customer.

> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `customers:all`, `customers:readonly`

# List customers (company and individual)

This endpoint returns a list of both company and individual customers

> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `customers:all`, `customers:readonly`

# Upload a file

Upload a file to attach to any resource that provides a `file_attachment_id`:
  - Customer Invoice
  - Supplier Invoice
  - Credit Notes

The maximum allowed file size is 100MB.
Note that this will not upload a file into the DMS (GED).


> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `file_attachments:all`

# List SEPA mandates

This endpoint allows you to retrieve all SEPA mandates associated with your company

> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `customer_mandates:all`, `customer_mandates:readonly`

# Cancel a Gocardless mandate

Cancels a specific Gocardless mandate by ID. The mandate must be in a cancellable state, having one of the following statuses: `pending_submission`, `submitted` or `active`.

> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `customer_mandates:all`

# Upload an appendix for a quote

Upload a file that will be an appendix attached to a quote.

Note that this will not upload a file into the DMS (GED).


> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `quotes:all`

# Send a quote by email

This endpoint allows you to send a quote by email to your customer.
This requires that the PDF file for that document has been generated
(this process can take a few minutes), so if you just created
the quote in our system, we may return a 409 error. You should
retry the request in a few minutes - if you receive a 204 response, that means
that the email is on its way. For more information about email sending, please
read \[this guide\](https://pennylane.readme.io/v2.0/docs/sending-documents-by-email).


> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `quotes:all`


# OpenAPI definition
```json
{
  "openapi": "3.0.1",
  "info": {
    "title": "Accounting",
    "contact": {
      "email": "tech@pennylane.com"
    },
    "version": "2.0"
  },
  "servers": [
    {
      "url": "https://app.pennylane.com"
    }
  ],
  "paths": {
    "/api/external/v2/quotes/{id}/send_by_email": {
      "post": {
        "operationId": "sendByEmailQuote",
        "summary": "Send a quote by email",
```

# List appendices of a quote

List appendices of a quote

> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `quotes:all`, `quotes:readonly`


# OpenAPI definition
```json

  "openapi": "3.0.1",
  "info": {
    "title": "Accounting",

      "email": "tech@pennylane.com"
    },

  },
  "servers": [
    {
      "url": "https://app.pennylane.com"
    }
  ],
  "paths": {
    "/api/external/v2/quotes/{quote_id}/appendices": {
      "get": {
```

> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `quotes:all`

> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `quotes:all`

# List supplier invoices

This endpoint returns a list of supplier invoices.

> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `supplier_invoices:all`, `supplier_invoices:readonly`

List invoice lines for a supplier invoice

> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `supplier_invoices:all`, `supplier_invoices:readonly`

# Import a supplier invoice with a file attached

This endpoint allows you to import a supplier invoice with a file
attached.


> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `supplier_invoices:all`

# Categorize a supplier invoice

Update the categories of a supplier invoice. You can pass categories that don't belong to the same category group. The sum of categories of a same group must equal `1`. In the following example, the two first categories belong to the same category group A, the sum of the weights is `1`. The third category belongs to a category group B, its weight is `1`.
```
[
  { "id": 59, "weight": "0.5" }, // category group A
  { "id": 33, "weight": "0.5" }, // category group A
  { "id": 65, "weight": "1" } // category group B
]
```


> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `supplier_invoices:all`

Some information is missing on the invoice and needs to be completed by SME.\n- `validation_needed`: The invoice is sent to the accountant and needs validation.\n- `complete`: The invoice has been validated by the accountant.\n",
```json
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
```

```json
                        "entry",
                        "validation_needed",
                        "complete"
                      ]

                    },

                      "type": "string",

                      "example": "20.0"
                    },
                    "remaining_amount_without_tax": {
                      "description": "The remaining amount without VAT to pay for the invoice to be considered paid",
                      "type": "string",
                      "nullable": true,
                      "example": "16.0"
                    },

                        "id"
                      ]
                    },

                      "type": "object",
                      "nullable": true,
                      "additionalProperties": false,
                      "properties": {
                        "id": {
                          "type": "integer",
                          "example": 456
```

```json
                      "example": false

                      "description": "The accounting state of the invoice.\n- `draft`: The invoice is not yet sent to the accountant.\n- `archived`: The invoice has been archived.\n- `entry`: The invoice is incomplete. Some information is missing on the invoice and needs to be completed by SME.\n- `validation_needed`: The invoice is sent to the accountant and needs validation.\n- `complete`: The invoice has been validated by the accountant.\n",

                      "enum": [
                        "draft",
                        "archived",
                        "entry",
                        "validation_needed",
                        "complete"
                      ]

                      "nullable": true,
```

# Match a transaction to a supplier invoice

This endpoint allows you to match a transaction to a supplier invoice.

You can match one transaction with one supplier invoice at a time. To match multiple transactions to a supplier invoice, you need to call this endpoint multiple times.
It's possible to match a transaction to multiple supplier invoices too.


> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `supplier_invoices:all`

# Match a transaction to a customer invoice

This endpoint allows you to match a transaction to a customer invoice. It is not applicable for draft invoices.

You can match one transaction with one customer invoice at a time. To match multiple transactions to a customer invoice, you need to call this endpoint multiple times.
It's possible to match a transaction to multiple customer invoices too.


> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `customer_invoices:all`

# Unmatch a transaction to a supplier invoice

This endpoint allows you to unmatch a transaction to a supplier
invoice.


> ℹ️
> This endpoint requires one of the following scopes: `supplier_invoices:all`

# Unmatch a transaction to a customer invoice

This endpoint allows you to unmatch a transaction to a customer invoice. It is not applicable for draft invoices.


> ℹ️
